text.description_html:
Laurey 39366, Swirl Foundry Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull

The Foundry Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull is a rustic kitchen cabinet handle that is well suited to traditional Americana homes. The swirl design adds a point of interest to this 3 inch cabinet pull that also serves to highlight the beauty of the oil rubbed bronze finish. The Foundry Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Foundry Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 39366 3 Inch Foundry Pull in Oil Rubbed Bronze:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 3/4"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
